title: "Candidate evidence"
description: "Use semantic evidence about candidate models to improve ranking beyond query-only controls."

::: {.hub-conclusion}
## Current conclusion

Candidate semantic profiles improved development ranking in fusion, but generalization and artifact custody remain unresolved.
:::

<div class="hub-decision-strip">
<div><strong>Practical decision</strong><br>
Adopt
</div>
<div><strong>Confidence and evidence boundary</strong><br>
Moderate confidence. Development-only evidence; diagnostic variants and incomplete construction artifacts do not establish hidden-test gains.
</div>
<div><strong>Next move</strong><br>
<a href="../../ideas/semantic-failure-clusters.qmd">Semantic failure clusters</a>: Group development failures to test whether recurring query types predict method weakness.
</div>
</div>

## Questions in this theme

<div class="hub-question-row">
<h3><a href="../../questions/candidate-evidence.qmd">Can candidate-side semantic evidence improve query-only retrieval?</a></h3>
<p>When choosing an LLM, does it help to consider what each candidate model is good at, not only compare the request with past requests?</p>
<p><strong>Current bounded answer</strong><br>Yes on development evidence, subject to the evidence limits below.</p>
<p><strong>Still open</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Which candidate evidence generalizes beyond development?</li>
<li>Which profile resolution is robust rather than diagnostic?</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="hub-question-row">
<h3><a href="../../questions/failure-conditions.qmd">When do promising signals fail?</a></h3>
<p>Which request types, evidence gaps, and operational constraints make a ranking or reference method unreliable?</p>
<p><strong>Current bounded answer</strong><br>Failures cluster around ambiguity, entity resolution, evidence custody, scope changes, and over-tuned fusion, but no complete predictor exists.</p>
<p><strong>Still open</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Can failure clusters be detected before a decision?</li>
<li>Can reliability-aware fusion improve without adding leakage?</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="hub-question-row">
<h3><a href="../../questions/query-only-routing.qmd">How far can query-only routing go?</a></h3>
<p>Can a new request be routed well by comparing it with historical requests, before using candidate responses?</p>
<p><strong>Current bounded answer</strong><br>Dense query neighbors are a useful stable control, but candidate-side evidence improved development results.</p>
<p><strong>Still open</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Which query representation transfers best beyond development?</li>
<li>Can cluster evidence help without unstable tuning?</li>
</ul>
</div>
